items.title: Young Snooky — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: The interviewee does not mention Albert Mangelsdorff; the interviewer mentions him in relation to a drummer who played with Jimmy and Jeannie.

ctx.x: Jeannie is still living, but Jimmy passed. Oh, that was a nice group, man.
The drummer that we saw with Albert Mangelsdorff in Munich, called him ―Iron Man‖, from Detroit, he played with Jimmy and Jeannie…
I didn‘t understand, what you was talking to him, but…
